relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with DNP rats, the expression of TRPV1 was lower in the P2X7 shRNA group (Figure 5), indicating that inhibition of P2X7R would reduce the expression of TRPV1 and achieve a therapeutic effect.

relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that P2X7R regulates the expression of PKCε upstream of TRPV1 and that P2X7R participates in DNP through the PKC/p38 MAPK pathway.

relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: We measured the expression of the TNF-α in the P2X7 shRNA group, and p38 inhibitor groups were lower than in the DNP group (p < 0.01; Figure 6A,B)

relationships.subject: p38 MAPK
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X7 shRNA and P38 inhibitors significantly reduced TRPV1 expression by downregulating the PKCε/P38 MAPK/NF-κB signaling pathway and inflammatory factors in dorsal root ganglia.

relationships.subject: P2X7R
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X7 shRNA reduced mechanical and thermal nociceptive sensitization in the DNP rats, suggesting that DNP in rats could be alleviated by silencing P2X7R.

key_findings: Intrathecal P2X7 shRNA and p38 inhibitor relieved hyperalgesia and lowered TRPV1, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta in DRG of diabetic neuropathic pain rats.
P2X7R acts upstream of TRPV1 via PKCε/p38 MAPK/NF-κB.
